verdicts.why: In S1E4 B-15 punches Sylvie to protect Renslayer on Lamentis, then frees Loki and Sylvie in front of Renslayer in the Time-Keepers' chamber and is knocked out and held in custody. That turn needs its own enemy stage.

The opening of 'The Variant' (S1E2) shows Sylvie enthrall C-20 at the 1985 fair, make her kill her Minutemen and take her hostage. Later in the same episode C-20 tells Mobius she gave away the Time-Keepers' location, so the whole stage is true from S1#2.
Coulson's team rescues Franklin Hall from Quinn's compound in 'The Asset' (S1E3), and Quinn escapes by helicopter. The capture comes in S1E13 and is the added stage.
In 'T.R.A.C.K.S.' (S1E13) Quinn shoots Skye at his Italian villa. Ward and Coulson storm in, Coulson holds a gun to Quinn's head and hits him, and Quinn is taken to the Bus and locked in the Cage.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Isabelle Hartley is a close friend of Lance Hunter who brings him into Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D., and the two run mercenary jobs together with Idaho. Hunter survives the car crash that kills her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hartley's close friend and fellow mercenary.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter's close friend, who brings him into S.H.I.E.L.D. and dies in a car crash.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
split.text: Hunter wants revenge on Carl Creel for Hartley's death, and he strikes a deal with Talbot so that she gets an honorable funeral.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hartley's close friend and fellow mercenary, who wants revenge for her death.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter's close friend, who brings him into S.H.I.E.L.D. and dies in a car crash.

verdicts.why: The Browning job and Hartley's death in the crash are in 'Shadows' (S2E1). Hunter going after Creel for revenge comes in 'Heavy Is the Head' (S2E2), so that fact goes in a split stage.
In the 'One Door Closes' flashback Hartley is already aboard the Iliad fighting Hydra. It is Bobbi who reveals that Fury gave her a secret mission to destroy the ship. Fury does not send Hartley.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Phil Coulson trusts Isabelle Hartley and brings her mercenary team into his S.H.I.E.L.D. He sends her to recover a mysterious object that turns out to be the Obelisk, and she dies on that mission.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The director who hires Hartley's team and sends her after the Obelisk.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Coulson trusts and hires. She dies on his mission.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
split.text: It comes out that Hartley belonged to Robert Gonzales's rival S.H.I.E.L.D. and was secretly spying on Coulson's team for him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The director who hired Hartley's team, not knowing she spied for Gonzales.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Coulson hired, unaware she spied for Gonzales. She died on his mission.

verdicts.why: Hartley works for Coulson and dies in 'Shadows' (S2E1), so the stage starts there. That she was part of Gonzales's faction comes out in 'One Door Closes' (S2E15), so it goes in a split stage instead of being dropped.

value.title: Agent Carter S1#3
value.text: Roger Dooley runs the SSR's hunt for Howard Stark and blames him for the deaths of his agents.

split.title: Agent Carter S1#7
split.text: Dooley digs into Howard's past at the Battle of Finow, but Fennhoff kills him before Howard is cleared.
split.on_a_card_about_b: SSR chief who blames Howard for the deaths of his own agents.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fugitive Dooley blames for the SSR agents' deaths.

verdicts.why: Dooley blames Stark for Krzeminski's death in 'Time and Tide' (S1E3), so the stage starts there. The Finow digging runs through S1E3 to S1E6 and Dooley dies in 'Snafu' (S1E7), so those facts go in a split stage instead of being dropped.
In the One-Shot, Howard calls the SSR case line and tells Flynn that Carter will co-head the newly created S.H.I.E.L.D. She is named co-head, not its sole head.

In 'The Lady in the Lake' (S2E1) Masters takes Underwood into FBI custody, reminds Jack that he got him the SSR job, and pushes him to play the long game. The later turn to violence is the added S2#8 stage.
In S2E8 Thompson overhears Frost ordering Masters to get the uranium. Masters uses the Memory Inhibitor on him and then sends Vega to kill Sousa, Thompson and Samberly.
In S2E9 Thompson offers to turn on Masters for a Council seat, but he really means to remote-detonate the cannon and kill Frost, and he hands Masters over to her. He only pretends to work with her.
Lucas first appears in 'Straighten It Out' (S2E2), walking into Pop's to talk to Luke, who tells Claire it was his estranged father. Their reconciliation only begins in S2E9.
Luke protects his father at the church in S2E8, and the summary of 'For Pete's Sake' (S2E9) ends with Cage beginning to reconcile with his father.

In 'No Strings' (episode 1) Vision already lives in his Mindspace with J.A.R.V.I.S. and F.R.I.D.A.Y. J.A.R.V.I.S. deletes himself in episode 2 and his funeral is in episode 3, so 'both live' is true at #1.

value.title: Daredevil S1#1
value.text: James Wesley handles Wilson Fisk's dealings with Nobu Yoshioka, who represents the Hand in Fisk's criminal alliance.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Hand's man in Fisk's alliance.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man, who handles Fisk's dealings with Nobu.

split.title: Daredevil S1#8
split.text: After Nobu berates Fisk over the ruined Black Sky shipment, Wesley questions what Nobu's people actually contribute, even though they take an equal share of the profits.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Hand's man in Fisk's alliance, whose share Wesley never quite understands.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man, who handles Fisk's dealings with Nobu.

verdicts.why: Wesley stands in for Fisk at the alliance meeting in S1E1 with Nobu present, and Nobu is dead by S1E9, so S1#11 is wrong. Wesley's doubts about Nobu's contribution come after the S1E8 meeting, so they go in a split stage.

value.title: Daredevil S1#8
value.text: James Wesley comes to Melvin Potter's workshop to report to Fisk while Melvin fits Leland Owlsley with an armored suit.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's suit maker, whose workshop Wesley visits.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man, who comes to Melvin's workshop.

verdicts.why: Their only shared scene is Wesley briefing Fisk at Melvin's workshop during Owlsley's fitting in S1E8, and no source has Wesley passing Melvin orders. That Fisk coerced Melvin with threats to Betsy is revealed in S1E11, so 'forced' and 'coerced' are cut from an S1#8 stage.
In S1E8 Wesley brings Vanessa to the penthouse because she is the one person who can comfort Fisk. In S1E10 he waits at the hospital after the poisoning. No source shows Vanessa relying on Wesley.
Evans stabs Fisk in the prison gym in S3E2, and Fisk spares him because of their plan. In S3E4 Matt learns Fisk paid him, and Evans is killed in S3E6, so the killing belongs in the added stage.
In S3E6 Fisk proposes 'an alternative' to Dex, who goes to the Bulletin dressed as Daredevil and kills Evans before he can give his taped confession.
In 'Hollywood Ending' (S2E10), worried about Frost, Manfredi breaks into Stark's estate, finds Stark and Carter eating with Wilkes, and agrees to distract Frost while they photograph her blueprints.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#13
value.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, ambushes Director Jeffrey Mace when his strength runs out and has his men take him captive.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Watchdogs' leader, who kidnaps Mace.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#14
split.text: Ivanov tortures the captive Mace with his knife and sneers at his attempts to pass as an Inhuman, until Coulson's team rescues him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Watchdogs' leader, who kidnaps Mace and tortures him with knives.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The director the Superior kidnaps and tortures, sneering at his Inhuman act.

verdicts.why: Mace is captured at the end of 'BOOM' (S4E13), but the knife torture and the rescue are in S4E14, so they go in a split stage. The LMD and Framework sentence is Aida's doing and is revealed in S4E15, not something between these two, so it is left out.
Madisynn appears only in episode 4. Wong portals her into court, where she testifies, and she leaves with Wong. There is no night out with Jennifer.
Jacobson makes Jennifer's suits in episode 5. In episode 8 she represents Leap-Frog against him, Murdock wins for Luke, and she and Daredevil then rescue him from Leap-Frog.
In episode 4 the judge lets Blaze keep practicing, so there is no court win. The matter ends when Wong and Walters send back the demons and threaten Blaze into complying with the cease-and-desist.
Kith's husband Peter kills himself in S3E5. Patseras is a former donor who accuses Kith of fraud, and Jeri later asks Trish to steal from him.
The man Jeri sends Trish after is Demetri Patseras, not Kith's husband, who is already dead by S3E5.
In S2E12 Turk is called an old associate of Jeri's. He takes a future favor instead of cash because he may need her to represent him someday.

Jean lets Peter into her mind and they reconcile over their losses. He takes Castle's bullet for her, she drops her attack and keeps him alive, then leaves the city. The film does not leave them as enemies.

Kilgrave sends Simpson after Trish in S1E3. In S1E4 Jessica asks if he still wants to stop Kilgrave and he brings her surveillance footage, and in S1E5 he helps capture Kilgrave. He turns on her only in S1E10-11.
Trevor says Morris grew up with Shang-Chi's mother in Ta Lo. Wenwu found Morris and took him out of Ta Lo to the Ten Rings' dungeon. Nothing shows him following Li out or staying with the family.
In the S.O.S. finale Lincoln watches Jiaying kill Agent Oliver. Skye tells him Jiaying murdered Gonzales and Raina, and he joins May against Alisha, so S2 leaves them as enemies.
Woo introduces himself to Monica outside Westview with his card trick in 'We Interrupt This Program' (episode 4), where they then work with Darcy.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#1
value.text: Joaquin Torres briefs Sam Wilson on Karli Morgenthau's Flag Smashers and tracks them to Switzerland, where one of them knocks him out during a robbery.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Flag Smashers' leader Joaquin gathers intel on.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An Air Force officer who gathers intel on Karli's group.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#2
split.text: Torres flies Sam and Bucky to Germany as they hunt Karli and her Flag Smashers.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Flag Smashers' leader Joaquin gathers intel on.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An Air Force officer who gathers intel to hunt Karli.

verdicts.why: Torres researches and tracks the Flag Smashers in episode 1, but Sam and Bucky only team up to hunt them in episode 2, where Torres flies them to Germany. That part goes in a split stage.
In episode 1 Torres gives Sam ground support in Tunisia, briefs him on the Flag Smashers, and sends him the Switzerland footage. The wiki says they befriend each other on that mission.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#1
value.text: Lance Hunter helps Daisy and Mack rescue Joey Gutierrez from the ATCU in Seattle.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps rescue Joey.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
split.text: On the mission to Hydra's castle, Hunter cheerfully warns Joey that every plan eventually turns to rubbish.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps rescue Joey and jokes about plans going to rubbish.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Hunter helps rescue and warns that every plan turns to rubbish.

verdicts.why: The Seattle rescue is in 'Laws of Nature' (S3E1), but the 'rubbish' exchange is on the Hydra castle mission in S3E10, so it goes in a split stage.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#1
value.text: Phil Coulson sends Daisy, Lance Hunter, and Mack to rescue Joey Gutierrez when his powers emerge.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The director who has Joey rescued.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
split.text: After Coulson has Andrew Garner assess Joey for Daisy's Secret Warriors, Joey joins the mission that rescues Coulson and Fitz from Hydra's castle.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The director who has Joey rescued and brought into the Secret Warriors.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Coulson has rescued, who later helps save him from Hydra.

verdicts.why: Joey is rescued in S3E1, but Garner assesses him at Coulson's request in S3E2. That fact is wrong at S3#1 and goes in the split together with the S3E10 castle rescue.
In 'The Star-Spangled Man' (episode 2) Walker and Hoskins join the truck fight, give Sam and Bucky a ride, and try to recruit them. The two then decide to split from Walker.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#5
value.text: Joseph Manfredi is Whitney Frost's former lover from her early days. When she comes to him for help, he lends her his men.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Manfredi's old flame, who comes to him for help.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Whitney's old flame, who lends her his men.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#7
split.text: After her husband's death, Whitney makes Manfredi her second-in-command, and he helps her kidnap Jason Wilkes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Manfredi's old flame, whom he helps after her husband's death.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Whitney's old flame, who helps her after her husband dies.

verdicts.why: Frost and Chadwick go to Manfredi for men in 'The Atomic Job' (S2E5), and Chadwick only dies in S2E6. Manfredi helping her after the death, as her second-in-command in S2E7, goes in a split stage instead of being dropped.

value.title: Ms. Marvel#3
value.text: Najma, leader of the Clandestines, wants Kamala Khan's bangle to open the way back to the Noor dimension, and she turns on Kamala when she resists.

split.title: Ms. Marvel#5
split.text: Kamala begs Najma not to abandon Kamran, and Najma sacrifices herself to close the Veil.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Clandestines' leader, who wants Kamala's bangle and dies closing the Veil.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The girl whose bangle Najma wants, who talks her out of abandoning Kamran.

verdicts.why: Najma turns on Kamala and attacks her at Aamir's wedding in episode 3. Her sacrifice is in episode 5, so it goes in a split stage instead of being dropped.

value.title: Ms. Marvel#2
value.text: Najma is Kamran's mother and the leader of the Clandestines.

split.title: Ms. Marvel#5
split.text: Najma dies closing the Veil, calling Kamran's name as she passes its energy on to him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Kamran's mother, who dies helping close the Veil.

verdicts.why: Kamran introduces Kamala to his mother Najma in episode 2. Her death closing the Veil is in episode 5, so it goes in a split stage instead of being dropped.
In 'Seeing Red' (episode 4) the Clandestines ambush the Red Daggers' lair in Karachi, Najma kills Waleed, and Kareem fights them.

value.title: Daredevil S1#1
value.text: Matt and Foggy help clear Karen Page of a murder she did not commit, and she joins their firm out of gratitude.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's boss, who helps clear her of murder.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A client Matt clears of murder, who joins his firm.

split.title: Daredevil S1#9
split.text: Karen becomes Matt's close friend as she digs into Wilson Fisk's crimes with Ben Urich.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's close friend and boss, who helps clear her of murder.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Matt clears of murder, who joins his firm.

verdicts.why: Karen is cleared and asks to work at Nelson and Murdock in 'Into the Ring' (S1E1). Fisk only goes public in S1E8, and she starts digging into him with Urich in S1E9, so that part goes in a split stage.

value.title: Jessica Jones S1#3
value.text: Kilgrave orders Will Simpson to kill Trish Walker, then orders him to walk off a balcony.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A cop Kilgrave orders to kill Trish.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The man who orders Simpson to kill Trish.

split.title: Jessica Jones S1#8
split.text: Simpson plants a bomb to kill Kilgrave, but Kilgrave leaves it for him and Simpson is badly hurt.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A cop Kilgrave orders to kill Trish, who later tries to kill him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The man who orders Simpson to kill Trish, whom he later hunts.

verdicts.why: Kilgrave sends Simpson after Trish and then off a balcony in 'AKA It's Called Whiskey' (S1E3). Simpson's attempt on Kilgrave's life with the bomb is in S1E8, so it goes in a split stage.

value.title: Jessica Jones S1#3
value.text: Kilgrave tells Jessica Jones to take care of Reva Connors, and Jessica kills Reva under his control.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A woman Kilgrave has Jessica kill.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Has Jessica kill Reva while under his control.

split.title: Jessica Jones S1#8
split.text: Reva had got hold of the files on the experiments done on Kilgrave as a child and buried them, and Kilgrave took control of her to find them.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hid the files on Kilgrave's childhood. He has Jessica kill her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Controls Reva to find the files, then has Jessica kill her.

verdicts.why: The relationship starts earlier than #8. The 'take care of her' flashback in which Jessica kills Reva is in S1E3, and the box is shown in S1E6. Its contents, the footage of Kilgrave's childhood experiments, are only revealed in S1E8, so the files go in a split stage.
